import math

int[][][] systems := [
    [[2, -1, 3, 7], [4, 1, -2, 3], [-3, 5, 1, -4]],
    [[1, 3, -2, 4, 6], [5, -2, 1, 3, -7], [-2, 4, 6, -1, 9], [3, 1, -4, 2, 5]],
]
for: system := systems[index]
    real64[][] a := real64(system)
    n := int(#a)
    for: k < n
        pivot := k
        for: k + 1 <= i < n
            if math.abs(a[i][k]) > math.abs(a[pivot][k])
                pivot = i
        if pivot != k
            a[k], a[pivot] = a[pivot], a[k]
        for: k + 1 <= i < n
            factor := a[i][k] / a[k][k]
            for: k <= j <= n
                a[i][j] -= factor * a[k][j]
    real64[] solution := array(nat(n), fill = 0.0)
    for: n > i >= 0
        sum := a[i][n]
        for: i + 1 <= j < n
            sum -= a[i][j] * solution[j]
        solution[i] = sum / a[i][i]
    println("system {index + 1}:")
    for: value := solution[i]
        variable := i + 1
        println("x{variable} = {value:.4}")
